title: An arm sorter that works the way the pack's arms do
from: Pack 0.6.24: the book said the arm reads each funnel's filter and to make the funnels the arm's outputs. A Mechanical Arm can't target a funnel that feeds a belt, and before 0.6.25 a belt output ignored its funnel.
question: how can I use a mechanical arm to take from one conveyor and sort to another based on what item it has, so it takes from belt one and decides to put it on belt 2 or belt 3 depending on the item
player: Has brass and a few Precision Mechanisms; three belts already laid out next to each other.
rubric: Puts a Brass Belt Funnel with a filter on the belt block the arm drops onto, one per output belt
Makes the belt block under each funnel the arm's output (not the funnel itself)
Says the arm only picks up an item one of its outputs takes, and that a belt block with no funnel takes anything
